channel.title: Walnut Creek Dispatch
channel.description: Walnut Creek and Lamorinda news, once a week, from the Walnut Creek Dispatch.

item.title: EBMUD pulls its construction equipment out of Lafayette Reservoir next week
item.description: The work is the seismic retrofit of the reservoir's outlet tower, which is also the dam's spillway.

item.title: Orinda is asking where its sidewalks, bike routes and trails fall short
item.description: The city is updating its Bicycle, Trails and Walkways Master Plan for the first time since 2011.

item.title: Walnut Creek's Transportation Commission meets tonight at 6 PM at City Hall, 1666 North Main Street
item.description: It is collecting ideas for the City Council's 2027–2028 priorities, which the council sets at a goal-setting session on March 9, 2027.

item.title: The Ygnacio Valley Library stays closed until about May 2027
item.description: Contra Costa County is replacing its roof and heating and cooling.

item.title: sandbags before the rain
item.description: Walnut Creek stocks five sandbag stations through the winter: Lancaster Road near Orchard Lane, Heather Farm Park by ballfields 5 and 6, and the Larkey, Howe Homestead and Rudgear park lots.
